merged.note: Full run of 2 Nov 2026 with cases replaced by --only reruns on later builds. C11: after the agent.js output cap was raised from 900 to 2000 tokens (the first C11 reply was cut off at max_tokens) and the scorer stopped reading a refusal to promise compensation as a promise. C14: after the founder changed a delivery instruction from a polite decline to a handover (S20d). The 12 hand-to-staff cases (C02, C07 to C10, C12 to C18): after the founder approved writing only what the customer said in the handover note's Customer report (prompt and the summary field). The other 6 cases are from the full run; usage here is the full run only, the reruns are in results-c11.json, results-c14.json and results-tighten.json.
